entities.summary: Aloisio da Milano, also known as Aloisio da Carezano, Aleviz Milanets, and Aleviz Fryazin, was an Italian architect who worked in the Grand Principality of Moscow from 1494 to c. 1515. He is also known as Aloisio the Old to distinguish him from Aloisio the New, another Italian master who worked in Russia.
